scope: Modal migration: canonical repository review, local client installation, and offline checks; no remote execution
publication_identity: The containing Git commit identifies this update; counters in historical_initial_package apply only to the original starter.

checks.name: Canonical GitHub source snapshot
checks.scope: All 30 original files were fetched at the reviewed commit and matched their Git blob SHAs.

checks.name: Local client lock and dependency installation
checks.scope: Public-PyPI uv.lock; 39 installed packages; no local torch module. This is not validation of the GPU dependency closure.

checks.name: Modal SDK and command contract
checks.scope: Offline import and actual Modal 1.6.3 help for app entrypoint, profile, log following and Volume download; --model-profile avoids Modal authentication --profile collision.

checks.name: Adapter boundary tests
checks.command: uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
checks.scope: Invalid requests, checkpoint path boundaries, Weave opt-in, durable failure/name guards, evidence export exclusions, child timeout cleanup/log streaming and safe dataset member extraction. All Modal operations mocked; no RPC.

checks.name: Python, shell, JSON and documentation checks
checks.scope: Python AST parsing, shell syntax, JSON parsing, 25 Bash documentation blocks, balanced fences and local links in README.md, experiment/README.md and docs/WORKBENCH_REVIEW.md.

checks.name: FlashAttention build architecture review
checks.scope: FlashAttention v2.8.3 setup.py uses FLASH_ATTN_CUDA_ARCHS; installer explicitly sets it to 90 alongside TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=9.0. No compiler/image build was run.

checks.name: Training interpreter symlink regression
checks.scope: Created a real symlink-backed stdlib venv, executed the launcher-selected Python and verified sys.prefix points to the venv and differs from sys.base_prefix. The complete unittest discovery run passed all 8 tests.

checks.name: Experiment changes bounded to interpreter selection
checks.scope: Compared to the reviewed GitHub base: experiment code changed only in launch.py to preserve the training interpreter symlink. Model profiles, preparation, reward, agent instrumentation, data split and training configuration were not changed.

not_verified: A live Surface Workbench or existing Modal credentials/workspace configuration
Modal image build, CPU FlashAttention compilation or full GPU dependency closure
GPU allocation, driver/kernel behavior, host/shared-memory sufficiency or model memory fit
Gated model access, model weight download or public dataset availability
Actual inference, MCP tool loop, reward delivery, gradient updates or weight synchronization in the cloud
Native checkpoint writing/reload, measured throughput, policy improvement or production transfer
Hosted W&B Models or Weave delivery, actual cloud cost or account-specific quota
next_runtime_gate: Run Modal prepare, then the two-step smoke and separate smoke-reload-eval actions before the baseline/main/final-evaluation sequence.

historical_initial_package.scope: Source review and local deployment-package checks only

checks.name: Python compilation, shell syntax and JSON parsing
Git exclusion and selected evidence eligibility

checks.scope: YAML parsed; one selected GPU, two narrow mounts, no published ports, socket, privileged mode or platform emulation

checks.name: GPU helper rejection cases
checks.scope: Scripted/local checks for Workbench and invalid runtime paths; no Docker daemon

checks.name: Endpoint probe local HTTP fixtures
checks.scope: Expected GET models only; normal JSON, invalid schema, oversized body, HTTP error, redirect rejection; credential/query URL rejection before requests

checks.name: Optional Workbench patch
checks.scope: Applied to exact Git blob-matching temporary originals; shell/JSON/mount checks; three scripted launcher modes and five scripted network cases

not_verified: A live Surface Pro or Ultra Workbench state
Live Docker network creation or the optional patch on the user machine
Actual Docker Compose rendering through the plugin, image build or runtime startup
NVIDIA container device visibility, memory capacity or ARM64 training support
Cloud allocation, private GitHub creation, authentication, source transfer or billing
Actual model inference, tool loop, training updates or checkpoint reload on this package
Hosted W&B Models logging or Weave delivery
